name: The Hinterlands
summary: The Hinterlands are a rugged, densely forested wilderness in eastern Lordaeron, tucked between the Plaguelands and the sea. The region is defined by ancient Amani troll temple ruins, the towering aeries of the Wildhammer clan at Aerie Peak, and a colossal Great Tree anchoring a mysterious rift to the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Land of Clashing Claims
sections.body: Long before humans or dwarves walked northern Lordaeron, the forest trolls of the Amani Empire held dominion over the Hinterlands. Following their defeat in the ancient Troll Wars, their empire shattered into disparate tribes. Centuries later, after the tragic War of the Three Hammers drove the Wildhammer dwarves from Grim Batol, the dwarves migrated north and made their home on the surface at Aerie Peak. Taming the native gryphons and embracing shamanic traditions, the Wildhammer constructed a massive skybound stronghold. The trolls viewed these surface-dwelling dwarves as unwelcome squatters upon ancestral lands, sparking a ceaseless feud of skirmishes and raids.

sections.title: Tribes of the Forest
sections.body: Three distinct forest troll factions occupy the dense canopy and crumbling stone temples. The brutal and fanatical Vilebranch tribe is the strongest, maintaining sprawling strongholds at the terraced temple-city of Jintha'Alor and the towering Altar of Zul. To the south, the weaker Witherbark tribe clings to Shadra'Alor and Hiri'Watha. The nomadic Revantusk tribe, long scorned by their cousins and lacking a true home, chose a radical path after the Third War: they struck a treaty with Thrall's New Horde. Bolstered by orcish and Forsaken aid, the Revantusk founded Revantusk Village on the eastern sea cliffs, carving out a defiant coastal bastion.

sections.title: The Slumbering Rift
sections.body: In the northern reaches of the Hinterlands stands Seradane, a colossal Great Tree sheltering a portal to the Emerald Dream. Deep within its boughs sits a massive mystical portal opening into the Emerald Dream, guarded by creatures of nature and members of the green dragonflight. However, a creeping shadow known as the Emerald Nightmare has begun to seethe across the portal's threshold, twisting once-benevolent drakes and dragonspawn into furious guardians of the grove.

faq.q: How do I get to the Hinterlands?
faq.answer: Both Alliance and Horde travelers approach from Hillsbrad Foothills, heading northeast through a mountain pass beyond Durnholde Keep. From there, Alliance travelers follow the road to Aerie Peak, while Horde adventurers cross eastward across the wilderness down to Revantusk Village on the eastern coast.
Falstad Wildhammer, Lord of Aerie Peak, leads the Wildhammer clan here. Thane Kurdran Wildhammer led the clan during the Second War.

faq.q: Why are the Revantusk trolls allied with the Horde?
faq.answer: Unlike the hostile Vilebranch and Witherbark tribes who rejected Horde emissaries, the nomadic Revantusk tribe sought protection and an end to wandering. The New Horde provided vital resources and soldiers to construct Revantusk Village along the coast, winning the tribe's fierce loyalty against local rivals.

Jintha'Alor is a massive, multi-tiered ancient troll fortress carved into the southern cliffs. It serves as the primary bastion of the ruthless Vilebranch tribe, thick with foul sacrificial altars, elite warriors, and witch doctors practicing blood rites in service to their dark loas.

faq.q: What is the Great Tree at Seradane?
faq.answer: Seradane is one of Azeroth's Great Trees, sheltering a portal to the Emerald Dream. Green dragons and wildkin watch over the grove.

Quel'Danil Lodge is a forest retreat maintained by Highvale high elves. Spared the Scourge's direct assault on Quel'Thalas, these rangers and scholars cooperate with the neighboring Wildhammer dwarves and share vital intelligence regarding the hostile forest trolls.

angles.text: For Wildhammer kin and visiting Bronzebeards alike, Aerie Peak represents dwarven life without stone ceilings—a place of soaring skies, shamanic power, and legendary gryphons.
The Hinterlands hold ancient Amani glory, where bloodlines clash over ancient temple steps and the Revantusk prove that forest trolls have an enduring place within the New Horde.
Though the Wildhammer dwarves cherish their fierce independence, aiding their outposts and the high elves of Quel'Danil builds critical goodwill against common troll threats.
Revantusk Village offers the Horde a vital eastern beachhead in northern Lordaeron, but survival requires beating back the ferocious Vilebranch tribe.
The ancient tree of Seradane holds a deep connection to the Emerald Dream, though the creeping rot of the Nightmare requires close and watchful vigilance.
